verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Electric power infrastructure has ignited several of the most destructive wildfires in recent history. Preemptive power shutoffs are an effective tool to mitigate the risk of ignitions from power lines, but at the same time can cause widespread power outages. verdicts.title: Holomorphic maps from complex discs intersecting families of hypersurfaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we establish second main theorems for holomorphic maps with finite growth index on complex discs intersecting families of hypersurfaces (moving and fixed) in projective varieties, where the small term is detailed estimate for various cases. Our results are generalizations and extensions of many previous second main theorems for holomorphic maps from $\mathbb C$ intersecting with hypersurfaces (moving and fixed) or moving hyperplanes.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns second main theorems for holomorphic maps from complex discs intersecting hypersurfaces in projective varieties—a Nevanlinna theory result. It says nothing about CNF formulas, resolution proof complexity, or arithmetic Hodge ranks of Hodge bundles.
